docs.title: Strutture di iterazione repeat-until e while-endwhile
docs.text:
Algoritmo: ricerca binaria

1   procedure ricbin(in N, Arr, X; out pos)
2       first = 1
3       last = N
4       pos = -1
3       while (first <= last  and  pos == -1) do
4           m = (first+last)/2
5           if (Arr(m) == X) then
6               pos = m
7           else
8               if (X < Arr(m)) then
9                   last = m-1
10              else
11                  first = m+1
12              endif
13          endif
14      endwhile
15  end procedure
